# Mohammad Mosallaei

> Licensed architect (Grade 1, Ministry of Road and Urban Development, Iran) based in Qazvin, Iran, with 20+ years of experience in architectural design, construction supervision, and inspection of reinforced concrete and steel buildings up to 6 floors. Currently expanding into BIM-driven data analytics and Power BI dashboards for construction project controls. Open to remote and international roles.

## Facts
- Full name: Seyed Mohammad Mosallaei (also: Mohammad Mosallaei)
- Location: Qazvin, Iran
- Current role: Architectural Supervisor, Qazvin Construction Engineering Organization (Nov 2007 – present)
- License: Grade 1 (design, supervision, implementation of buildings), Ministry of Road and Urban Development, Iran, since 2007
- Education: M.Sc. Architectural Engineering, Qazvin Islamic Azad University (QIAU), 2003
- Prior roles: Technical Office Expert, MAMMUT Co. (Mashhad Combined Cycle Power Plant, 2011); Architectural & Structural Supervisor, Housing Foundation of Islamic Revolution (2006–2009)
- Emerging focus: BIM, Power BI, construction data analytics, AI for AEC
- Availability: open to remote / international work (Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Europe, GCC), relocation with visa sponsorship where required
